data.long_meaning: Ishaana is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ishana’, which means ‘lord’ or ‘god’. The name Ishaana is often used to refer to the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi. She is also known as the goddess of fertility, happiness, and auspiciousness. In Hindu mythology, Lakshmi is depicted as having four arms, holding a lotus, a bowl of gold coins, a fan, and a lotus bud. She is often invoked during rituals and ceremonies to bring wealth, prosperity, and good fortune.
